text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zeroual, a year after his election, is driven by the firm commitment to restore security and stability.
- 18 civilians were killed in two operations in Medea, south of Algiers.
- A poll shows 71 percent of voters endorsing the constitution change, 17 percent intend to vote "no" and the rest undecided.
- Islamist party Hamas is expected to announce today its position on the referendum vote.
